description: This file defines unary operations for MaskedTensor objects in PyTorch, including supported functions, in-place variants, and internal helper functions for applying these operations.

methods.name: _unary_helper
methods.description: Helper function to apply unary operations on MaskedTensor, handling sparse tensor layouts and in-place modifications.

methods.name: _torch_unary
methods.description: Factory function to create unary functions that do not modify in place.

methods.name: _torch_inplace_unary
methods.description: Factory function to create in-place unary functions.

methods.name: _is_native_unary
methods.description: Checks if a function is a native unary function supported by the module.

methods.name: _apply_native_unary
methods.description: Applies a native unary function if supported, otherwise returns NotImplemented.
